install: Copy or symlink packs/<name>/ into <project>/.harness/skills/<name>/ and packs/_shared/ into <project>/.harness/skills/_shared/ (todo-32 registry automates this with pin+hash verification); the T30 loader discovers them from .harness/skills automatically.
